newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: SOCCER-BERGER TO BE NEW BASLE COACH.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-BERGER TO BE NEW BASLE COACH.

text.p: Swiss club Basle said on Monday that Germany's Jorg Berger would take over as coach of the struggling first division side next season.
Berger, who led Schalke 04 to a place in the UEFA Cup before leaving the German club last October, replaces Karl Engel who moved to second division side Lugano last week.
The 52-year-old Berger has also coached Cologne and Eintrach Frankfurt.
Basle, upset by second division Servette in the round of 16 of the Swiss Cup, are currently in last place in the first division standings with just one win in five matches.
